name: Porrazo
description: Porrazo (Parosso, Parear) is a fishing game from Mexico/Southwest USA. Play a card; if it matches a table card, capture it and any cards in ascending sequence. Matching the previous player's card = porrazo (bonus). First to 61 wins.

overview.description: Porrazo (Parosso, Parear) is a fishing game from Mexico/Southwest USA. Play a card; if it matches a table card, capture it and any cards in ascending sequence. Matching the previous player's card = porrazo (bonus). First to 61 wins.

history.origins: Introduced from Mexico to Southwest USA end of 19th century. First reference: Philip Firmin 'Contra Parazzo' (San Francisco Argonaut 1900). C. D. Willard rules (1901). Table Talk (1903), In and Out Door Card Games (1904). USPCC Parosso/Parear 1909-1924.
timeline: 1901: Willard rules in Southern California Practitioner.
Present: Played by families in California.
history.cultural: Spanish terms (ronda, porrazo, limpia, tendido) modified by American players.
history.evolution: Related to Ronda (Morocco) and Cuarenta (Ecuador). Ronda/rondine, porrazo, limpia, tendido mechanics.

setup.deck: Standard 52 cards. A (low) to K (high). Suits irrelevant.
setup.dealing: 3 cards each, then play. Repeat until deck exhausted. Once per dealer turn: deal tendido (4 face-up) after a 3-card deal.
setup.equipment: 52 cards, cribbage board or paper for score.

rules.objective: Reach 61 points first. Score via ronda/rondine, porrazo/counter porrazo/san benito, limpia, cards in place, tendido, and card count.
rules.gameplay: 1. **Ronda/Rondine**: After each 3-card deal, players with pairs announce 'ronda', with trips 'rondine'. After those 3 played, highest scores (K=4/12, Q=3/9, J=2/6, 2-A=1/3). 2. **Capture**: Play a card. Match = capture matched + ascending sequence (A above K). No match = card stays. 3. **Porrazo**: Previous play captured nothing; you play matching card = porrazo (bonus). Next player can counter porrazo with 3rd matching; 4th = san benito (instant win). 4. **Limpia**: Capture all table cards; score by last card rank. 5. **Cards in place**: A/2/3/4 played without capture so table count = card value; score that many. 6. **Tendido**: Dealer deals 4 face-up once; score A-4 in place, pairs/trips/fours.
keyRules: Sequences turn corner: A above K, 2 above A.
Porrazo only when previous card captured nothing; must match exactly.
Cards in place: only time capture can be forgone.
Last player to capture gets remaining table cards when deck exhausted.

strategy.basic: Announce ronda/rondine. Avoid setting up porrazos. Use cards in place when beneficial.
strategy.intermediate: Bluff ronda rank. Time porrazos; risk san benito for counter porrazo.
strategy.advanced: Track table composition. Save matching cards for porrazo opportunities. Tendido placement.

variations.name: Cards in Excess of 26
variations.description: 2p/2 teams: card score = excess over 26 (half normal).

variations.description: USPCC: sequences end at K; A always low.

scoring.description: Cumulative. Ronda/rondine, porrazo/counter porrazo, limpia, cards in place, tendido, card count. First to 61 wins.

synthesis.shortDescription: Fishing: play to capture. Porrazo = match previous. Ronda, limpia, cards in place. First to 61.
